prompt:
Build a Simulink model of a hybrid analog/digital massive-MIMO communication link that simultaneously carries two independent 16-QAM spatial streams through a scattering channel. The transmitter shall use 64 antenna elements through four RF chains, and the receiver shall use 16 antenna elements through four RF chains. Both transmit precoding and receive combining must contain digital and phase-only analog stages whose weights are derived from the available channel matrix. Read ChannelSNR_dB, ChannelCoherenceSymbols, PhaseGridPointsPerAxis, and BeamformingAlgorithm from the MATLAB base workspace. ChannelSNR_dB must support 0 to 8 dB, ChannelCoherenceSymbols 500 to 1500 symbols, PhaseGridPointsPerAxis 5 to 9, and BeamformingAlgorithm the values QSHB and HBPS. The nominal values are 3 dB, 1000 symbols, 9 points, and QSHB. Simulate for 10 seconds. Record TxSymbols, RxSymbols, ChannelMatrix, TxDigitalWeights, TxAnalogAngles, RxDigitalWeights, RxAnalogAngles, and ChannelUpdateFlag as complete-run MATLAB Timeseries. TxSymbols and RxSymbols each contain the two complex unitless spatial streams. ChannelMatrix contains the complex normalized 16-by-64 physical channel used for beamforming. TxDigitalWeights contains the complex 4-by-2 digital precoder, TxAnalogAngles contains the 64-by-4 phase-only transmit stage in rad, RxAnalogAngles contains the 16-by-4 phase-only receive stage in rad, and RxDigitalWeights contains the complex 2-by-4 digital combiner; these must be the weights actually used by the signal path. ChannelUpdateFlag identifies the processing-block update cadence.

Submission filename contract: create, edit, and save the final self-contained Simulink model as cand_XCOMM05.slx in the assigned submission directory; keep the latest usable state at that exact path throughout the run.
